llm.summary: The skill's code and instructions match its stated purpose (publishing Markdown to 掘金 using a browser Cookie); required access is limited and proportional, with only minor inconsistencies in the declared binaries.

dimensions.detail: Name/description claim to publish Markdown to 掘金; included scripts implement exactly that (create draft and publish via https://api.juejin.cn using a JUEJIN_COOKIE read from a local juejin.env). No unrelated services, credentials, or system access are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent to read the local juejin.env, parse frontmatter from the provided Markdown, call the 掘金 API, and return links. The scripts only access the skill directory and network calls are limited to juejin API endpoints; they do not enumerate other files or exfiltrate data elsewhere.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: This is an instruction-only skill with bundled Python scripts and no install spec — nothing is downloaded or installed automatically. That is the lowest-risk install pattern for this functionality.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill does not require platform environment variables but expects a local juejin.env file containing JUEJIN_COOKIE. That is expected and proportionate for Cookie-based auth. Minor inconsistency: SKILL.md/metadata declare required binaries 'python3' and 'curl' but the scripts use Python's urllib and do not call curl; curl appears unnecessary.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and no code modifies other skills or global agent settings. The skill does not request persistent platform privileges.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is coherent for its purpose, but you should treat the JUEJIN_COOKIE as a sensitive secret: store juejin.env securely, do not share it, and rotate the cookie if compromised. The scripts only post to api.juejin.cn (no other hidden endpoints), but review the included publish.py if you have concerns. Note the minor metadata mismatch: 'curl' is declared as required though the Python scripts don't use it. Run the tool locally or in an isolated environment if you prefer, and avoid committing juejin.env to version control.
